sentences.en: The long-range forecast says we will have a mild winter.
sentences.zh: 长期预报说我们将有一个温和的冬天。

sentences.en: Isn't it a mild winter this year? Makes life easier.
sentences.zh: 今年不是有个温和的冬天吗？让生活更轻松。

sentences.en: Surrounded by the sea, Japan has a mild climate.
sentences.zh: 被海洋环绕，日本气候温和。

senses.zh: 温和的；轻微的；淡味的；文雅的；不含有害物质的 -
